nodes.question: What are the goals of the National Cultural Flows Research Project (NCFRP) in Australia?
nodes.answer: The NCFRP aims to support Indigenous-led science by assessing Aboriginal cultural water values, developing culturally appropriate methodologies, and recommending policy changes to improve water management and recognition of cultural flows.
